games.name: You Got Me Killed!
games.description: Two players share one body: one controls the legs, the other the arms. Survive endless monster hordes, evolve your skills, summon bosses and blame each other for every death in this co-op roguelite bullet heaven.

games.name: Drunk Golf
games.description: Drunk Golf is a 1-8 player multiplayer game where the more drunk you are -> the further you shoot, but it also makes you wobblier. Master the physics-based swings, race & drift across multiple courses, customize your look and mess with friends on the way to the lowest score.

games.name: One More Jackpot!
games.description: Your arcade is dying. Nobody comes in. So you play every machine yourself. An active arcade incremental: smash, upgrade, wire it up, hit the JACKPOT!

games.name: Your "Thing"
games.description: Finally, you can grow your own little thing. Water it, feed it, and experiment with your technique to shape how it grows. Every mushroom has its own size, patterns, and quirks. It lives right on your desktop, reacts to your touch, and sometimes gets up to mischief. How big will yours get?

games.name: Buzzwire
games.description: Host your own buzz-in quiz show. Run it from your PC, put the board on your stream or Discord, and friends buzz in from their phones with a 6-letter room code. Or hand out controllers and play on one TV.

games.name: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival
games.description: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival is a cultivation survival game built around card-based interactions. Trapped in a mysterious realm that drains your lifespan but brims with spirit power, you must cultivate, survive, fight, and find a way to escape.

games.name: The Last Grave Job
games.description: Online co-op horror for up to 4 players. Sneak into a cemetery at night, find the right graves, dig up the loot and haul it back to your wheelbarrow. Stay quiet, avoid the Keeper and get out alive.

games.name: One More Pop
games.description: A cozy first-person incremental game about popping one million balloons. Shoot pins across a sunny meadow, chain combos and lightning, grow a constellation of 50 upgrades and watch the sky turn from sunrise to a starry night.

games.name: Golf Sim Sim
games.description: Start with a bedsheet, a bargain-bin launch monitor, and a dream. Beat 40 arcade golf challenges, earn cash, and install 20 upgrades as you turn a janky garage setup into the ultimate home golf simulator.

games.name: How to Hunt
games.description: A 1-4 player physics based hunting simulator. You and your friends crash your boat while on vacation. You must survive till you find a way back home.

games.name: Astral Wizards
games.description: Pick a wizard, walk into the swarm and let your spells fire on their own. A neon pixel-art bullet heaven with 30 worlds across 3 galaxies, laws that bend the rules, ENDLESS boss marathons and 13 wizards to master. Evolve 24 weapons into screen-filling light shows. No ads, no microtransactions.

games.name: Crafty Idle
games.description: Crafty Idle is a Minecraft inspired idle RPG where every skill strengthens the rest. Mine and craft your way to the strongest gear, take down monsters that each have their own weakness to exploit, and optimize your farming by chasing down the best genes. Progress never stops, even offline.

games.name: Caldera County
games.description: Your callsign is Air Attack 51. Circling overhead, your job is to call in aerial drops and direct ground crews against a fire that spreads with the wind, terrain and fuel. You must hold the line and protect every structure you can, but keeping people safe (including your units) is top priority.

games.name: Cozy Corner Cafe
games.description: Brew, upgrade, and relax! Build your dream coffee shop in Cozy Corner Cafe, a charming idle tycoon game. Automate prep stations, hire staff, handle in-store and online orders, and unlock upgrades through an extensive skill tree.

games.name: The Long Mine
games.description: An incremental mining game with fully destructible caves. Every pickaxe strike removes an actual piece of rock. Mine ores, sell them, and buy upgrades. Upgrades are not just +10% damage. Equipment and Curses change how you mine, move and explore. Combine them to create your own build.

games.name: Note Defender: A Sight Reading Arcade
games.description: Memorize the notes on the treble and bass staffs as well as 9 ledger lines above and below them. This covers every key of a standard 88 key piano and most instruments.

games.name: Those UnderHex
games.description: A strategy roguelite about rebuilding the portal lands. Reveal dark hexes with beams of light and bring supplies home. Protect your workers, combine tower weapons and face successive monster waves. Each night, your people need food and shelter.

games.name: VoltHaven
games.description: Build electric grid in small settlement. Advance from outdated generators to modern powerplants, use fossils and renewables. Accomodate growing customer base and weather changes. Farms or mines provide extra income. Map-free layout with drag-and-drop simplicity. Simulation based on european data.

games.name: Mine a Little
games.description: Mine a Little is a fun and relaxing mining game! Control your pickaxe with your mouse, smash rocks, and collect valuable ores! Upgrade your pickaxe, break tougher rocks, and unlock new mining areas as you work your way toward becoming the ultimate miner!

games.name: Idle Puzzler
games.description: Puzzle shops don't run themselves. Yours will, eventually. Solve Sudoku, word locks and colour codes, hire staff who keep solving while you're away, and watch a market stall grow into something much bigger.

games.name: Jester`s Anger
games.description: A fast deckbuilding roguelike boomer shooter where your deck is your ammo. Hurl paint cards, playing cards and tarot spells to smash marble chess pieces to rubble, heal on their shards, and take revenge on The Hands - the giant chess player who ate the Jester's cake.

games.name: Coal Rush 1990
games.description: Eastern Europe, 1990s. Janusz is 21,370,000 PLN in debt, and an inherited coal mine might be his only way out! Dig for resources, hire workers, build machines, and automate production. Start with a shovel, build a mining empire, and pay off your debt before the creditors come knocking!

games.name: Dash It!
games.description: A pixel platformer about jumping and dashing. Race up to 8 players in real time, chase the world No. 1 ghost in Time Attack, clear 72 stages across 12 themes, and build and share your own maps. Hang out in the lobby, change outfits and decorate your own house.

games.name: Gridbound
games.description: GRIDBOUND is a co-op arcade action game on a shifting LED floor. Dodge red hazards, activate blue objectives, and reach green safe tiles. Coordinate with your teammates, react fast, and stay alive as the grid changes around you.

games.name: Alt-Tab Legend
games.description: Ever seen that guy at the internet café running eight games at once? Your turn. Build the PC, set up the keyboard, raise a few Keysprites to mash keys for you, and open more games every night. You'll walk out of the café a winner, and there's a lot more waiting for you after that!

games.name: Friday at Ours
games.description: Friday at Ours is a time management-adventure game about overcoming your anxiety and visiting a party you weren't invited to.

games.name: Multi Miner Madness
games.description: A mining party game for up to four players. Drill for ore, haul it up and sell it, then spend the money on bigger drills, bombs and rams. Play on one screen with friends on the couch, or online through Steam.

games.name: Boo! Boo! Train!
games.description: A cozy train journey through a valley that keeps its own time. Drive slowly, pick a line at every junction, stop for the view and whistle at the neighbours. One real hour is one day in Pinewind Valley, and the season turns every week. Nothing to build, nothing to fail.

games.name: Loaded Bones
games.description: Loaded Bones is a poker-inspired dice roguelike where every roll can change your fate. Build powerful combinations, collect game-changing Keepsakes, unleash mystical Incantations, and chase outrageous scores as you gamble your way through a supernatural world to challenge the Devil himself.

games.name: Psst!
games.description: Sit down with friends, give a few hints, and try not to give your secret away. In this party game, close guesses earn you points, but an exact answer knocks you out. Play as cats across five word-game modes, online with friends or solo with bots.

games.name: Toque: Restaurant Tycoon
games.description: A restaurant tycoon where you are part of the crew. Work wherever you want, in the kitchen, at the register or on the floor, build your place yourself and pick one of four restaurant types. Grow your menu with cooks who know the dishes and rise above the city's rival restaurants.

games.name: Spuskaemsa!
games.description: A cooperative roguelike looter-shooter (1–4 players). Descend into the infinite Buffer, explore procedurally generated floors, scavenge for supplies, and battle its inhabitants. Rescue your comrades and upgrade your elevator. Godspeed!

games.name: Alchemist's Codex
games.description: Run a small alchemy shop and discover recipes by experiment. Grind, boil, distill and brew real ingredient properties, not fixed recipes. Take commissions, buy from the merchant, gather in your yard, and fill your Codex on the way to becoming a master alchemist.

games.name: Paint the Town
games.description: One morning, every color in town is gone. Grab a brush and bring it back: paint houses, cars, trees and towers until the gray city glows again. A calm, satisfying first-person incremental game — from a single brush to a paint cannon. Almost half a million square meters are waiting.

games.name: Fire Buller
games.description: Throw a flaming bull from a baseball stadium as far as it goes: over the city, past the Moon and Mars, to the edge of the universe and on to 10^1000 km. Wherever it lands, it crashes and rampages. Distance times destruction buys a stronger arm and twenty wilder bulls.

games.name: 50 Trillion Grains Of Sand
games.description: Dig through 50 trillion grains of sand in a first-person incremental digging sim. Start with a spoon, buy bigger tools, and put machines and Egyptian gods to work as you uncover a buried pyramid and discover the treasure hidden in its tomb.

games.name: Junk Mountain
games.description: One wedding ring is buried in a mountain of over 30,000 pieces of junk. Dig by hand, sweep up iron with a magnet, sell it at the scale and upgrade everything — from a backyard junkyard through a scrapyard, a port and a landfill all the way to orbit, until the junkyard runs itself.

games.name: Sort The Pandas
games.description: Thousands of pandas, two amazing worlds and one mission – put everything perfectly in place! Over 5,000 pandas are waiting for you in a shop full of shelves and a lush bamboo grove. Every panda you place brings you closer to perfect order. Level up your skills and see how many pandas you can sort!

games.name: TaskBound Saga
games.description: An idle JRPG that sits above your taskbar. Four heroes fight through 12 realms on their own while you use your computer. Open the chests they earn, equip the gear and upgrade your party.

games.name: Couch Potato
games.description: A collection of party games for up to sixteen people on one TV, with the phones already in your pockets as controllers. Hop on the couch, scan the code and you're in. Fight, fish, feast, hop and scrum, and unlock new weapons, arenas, pets and rods as the night goes on.

games.name: Don't Burn Out!
games.description: A block-pushing puzzle game in corporate hell, where you must confront your boss and escape the soul-draining workplace before you literally burn out. Solve over 100 handcrafted & unique puzzles that will require you to think strategically, with each step bringing you closer to flames!

games.name: Cheese Panic
games.description: An asymmetric co-op stealth action game: one player is the Cat, up to four are mice. Raid a house, a factory and a dungeon for food, distract the predator and haul the loot together before you get caught. Silly physics, proximity voice chat and random events in every match.

games.name: Aposis: Infinity Hero
games.description: A sci-fi roguelike RPG about an agent from the past awakened deep inside the Cradle, a colossal AI-controlled megacity.

games.name: Arcana Clash
games.description: A 2–6 player tarot card battler. Each of the 78 cards has two faces — upright and reversed — and you choose which one to unleash every time you play. Strike, curse, or turn the whole table upside down, and outlast your rivals before the Clock of Fate swallows everyone.

games.name: Caramba Caballeros
games.description: Caramba Caballeros is a first-person pirate roguelike for 1–4 players. Explore islands and hunt for treasure by day. Defend your ship from enemy waves by night. Battle other pirates in a battle royale, solo or in teams, with matchmaking and custom lobbies.

games.name: Bazaar Below Zero
games.description: Don Morsa has kidnapped you and put you to work digging ice to stock his bazaar. You obey… but every tunnel you dig brings you a little closer to the way out. A co-op incremental for 1–4 players: sell to seals, upgrade your tools, hire penguins and plan the great escape.

games.name: Sunbed Simulator
games.description: Take over an unlicensed beach with a few sunbeds and become king of the coast! In this first-person business sim, serve guests, hire staff and grow your resort – solo or in online co-op with friends. Bribe the police and sabotage the hotel next door. On this beach, you make the rules!

games.name: Greed, the dice game
games.description: One more roll could change everything. Play with up to three friends or take on bots in a dice game of risky choices, devilish bargains, and playful table mischief. Bank your points, push your luck, and make the table your own.

games.name: GermShake
games.description: A pixel-art roguelike where you play a germ spreading through Shake City one handshake at a time. Mutate, dodge the immune system, and survive the sink.

games.name: Jingle Janitor
games.description: Your first night as Santa's janitor, and the elves partied all night. Sort a gloriously messy workshop until every toy part sits on its shelf, learn handy magic, cheer up the elves and save Christmas. Cozy first-person tidying, alone or with a friend on the couch.

games.name: Tiny Crimes
games.description: Who needs money when you can sneak your way into anywhere? Team up with your fellow rats, explore different stores, grab all the supplies, and fulfill your community’s peculiar requests… But watch out! Things can get out of paw pretty quickly.

games.name: Multi Purpose Wheel Incremental
games.description: Rotate everything in this new spin on the Incremental genre! Rotate satisfying contraptions to earn interconnected currencies. Upgrade the contraptions to earn more, earn faster, and earn whackier. Unlock new contraptions to expand your rotating horizons.

games.name: POKUS
games.description: Sling spells and shatter friendships in a chaotic wizard tavern. In this online card battler for 2-6 player, play as petty mages whose hexes hilariously backfire. Break fragile alliances and haunt your friends from the grave in frantic 15-minute bouts of magical mayhem.

games.name: Default Zombie Shooter
games.description: You and your team woke up in a ruined city. Hordes of zombies roam the streets. There will be no answers. Grab a gun and shoot!

games.name: Kixball
games.description: Kixball is top-down physics football where you are one player on the pitch. No animations, no auto-aim: just you, the ball and the walls. Train, earn transfer offers and rise from the lowest division in your career, or play with up to 3 friends on one screen.

games.name: Bibliopyre
games.description: A magical storm and a goblin horde tore a million forbidden pages from the Great Library. As the Warden Mage, burn them all: sweep piles with waves of fire, send ash flying home, and hear every book chime into place to the beat of the music.

games.name: Before We Sink
games.description: Your island is sinking and the sea rises every minute. Gather wood, patch a wrecked boat and escape before the water swallows everything. Explore cursed islands, fight pirates and skeletons, and sail a galleon through storms, alone or in co-op for up to 5 players.

games.name: MUTINY!
games.description: MUTINY! is a multiplayer platformer fighter game that allows up to 10 players per round! Using different kinds of bombs and the power of physics, ensure your victory as the last man standing on pirate ships, treacherous waters, and other dynamic maps that aren't exactly on your side either.

games.name: Cornerwitch
games.description: Cornerwitch is a cozy idler game that sits on the corner of your screen. Study new spells and advance through a magical journey. Unlock cosmetics to dress up your little witch, level up and become stronger.

games.name: DYNASTY: Silk & Blood
games.description: 1980. You have $5 million and a family name. Build companies, conquer markets, marry, raise your heirs. Rival dynasties never rest and the world never waits. You will die. Your dynasty must not.
